details:
I want to adjust and save post-processing settings per world.

When I visit a world that I've never been to before, I want to see it exactly as the world author intended, with all post-processing effects displayed at the author's chosen intensity. At my discretion, I want to be able to dial back or disable the effects listed below, and I want my settings to be remembered for the next time I visit that world.

# Bloom

- **Status:** Available as a global slider, but lacking per-world control.

- **Motivation:** Tasteful use of bloom can look good, but it's too intense in some worlds. Sometimes I turn off bloom in one world and then forget to turn it on again later. As a result, I miss out on tasteful uses of bloom in other worlds until I remember to reactivate it.

# Chromatic Aberration

- **Status:** Unavailable (highest priority).

- **Motivation:** Causes uncomfortable image distortion in VR.

# Vignette

- **Status:** Unavailable (medium priority).

- **Motivation:** Causes uncomfortable stereoscopic brightness differences in VR.

# Ambient Occlusion

- **Status:** Unavailable (medium priority).

- **Motivation:** Sometimes causes the eyes of anime avatars to look creepy.

# Grain

- **Status:** Unavailable (low priority).

- **Motivation:** In rare cases, world authors overuse it.
title: Per-World Post Processing Settings
